lines.zh: 我端着弩在废墟间移动
lines.en: I move through the ruins with my crossbow up.

lines.zh: 靴子踩过碎石,声音很轻
lines.en: My boots crackle softly over rubble.
I advance along a broken wall.
My cloak sweeps through the dust.
My squad has long been gone.
I keep my aim steady with each step.
My breathing is heavy under the visor.
I shift to a new firing angle.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方没有声音
lines.en: Nothing sounds where I walk.
I stop, then move on.
Crossbow up, my shoulder slightly tilted.
I round a fallen column.
Moss has grown in my armour's seams.

lines.zh: 我朝着有动静的地方去
lines.en: I head toward the noise.
My pace is slow, but sure.
I am standing here once again.
I hold the crossbow, motionless.
I check the string.
Nothing readable under the visor.
I lift the bow arm a little.
I have no need to speak.

lines.zh: 我想不起来为谁而战了
lines.en: I cannot recall whom I fought for.
I wait for a target.
Dried blood stains my uniform.
I draw one slow breath.

lines.zh: 我站得笔直,像在接受检阅
lines.en: I stand straight as if on inspection.
I listen to something in the wind.
My finger rests on the trigger.
I raise the crossbow.
You are standing in my line of fire.
Eyes behind the visor are on you.
You are not my enemy.
I do not know you.

lines.zh: 你的装束不像审判庭的人
lines.en: You do not dress like the tribunal.
I lower the crossbow, slowly.
No one should be here.

lines.zh: 手放在我看得见的地方
lines.en: Keep your hands where I can see them
I can see you hesitating.
The blow forces me back half a step.
My armour caught some of it.
I grit my teeth and re-cock.
My visor has been knocked askew.

lines.zh: 箭匣被撞歪，我重新扶正
lines.en: The bolt case was knocked askew; I set it straight

lines.zh: 隔着面罩，我压住喘气声
lines.en: Behind my mask, I smother my breathing
Blood seeps through my armour's seams.

lines.zh: 靴跟钉在原地，队列不散
lines.en: My heel stays planted; the rank holds
I will not abandon the crossbow.
No one in the ranks complains of pain.

lines.zh: 我不该被这种东西吸引
lines.en: I should not be drawn to this.
I press the crossbow down.
I have not eaten in a long time.
I extend one hand.
Under the visor, I swallow.
This does not follow regulations.
I take it anyway.
Do not think I will put the crossbow down.
My crossbow stays raised.
I will remember this kindness.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肩上,我稳住了
lines.en: You hit my shoulder; I held.
My armour caught you.
A formation's spacing must not break
Do not touch my crossbow.
The impact pushed us both back.
I remember this is not a fight.
I turn the crossbow sideways, and you understand
Too close to loose a bolt.
Back out of my crossbow's span
Keep your distance from me.

lines.zh: 这身制服不适合谈这个
lines.en: This uniform is not made for this.
I push the visor up a little.

lines.zh: 我很久没和人靠这么近
lines.en: I have not stood this close to anyone in ages.
Let us hold this wall together.
I set the crossbow aside.

lines.zh: 面罩下面，我在数你的脚步
lines.en: Under my mask, I count your footsteps
There is no such thing in the ranks.
But I do not object.
I have a post before dawn.
Just for tonight, nothing more.
I hook it up with a finger.
This is not my supply.
I check it over.
This thing still works.
The phalanx's bolts are mine to keep.
I wipe it clean with cloth.
Heavier than it looks.
I keep it against need.
I tuck it into my strap.
Now I have one at last.
Target confirmed.
I level the crossbow.

lines.zh: 弩上了弦，审判庭的方阵列好。
lines.en: Crossbow strung; the tribunal's square forms.
The wind favors me and fights you.
My sight rests on your shadow
Tribunal rules: warn first.
My finger is on the trigger.
I loose on the count of three.
Do not make me loose the bolt.
Behind the visor, I aim.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的移动调整射角
lines.en: I adjust my angle to your movement.

lines.zh: 你每次呼吸都会让准星偏一点
lines.en: Each breath shifts my sight.
The wind changed; I wait.
I step behind the wall to re-cock.
I hear your boots.

lines.zh: 这座废墟的每条缝我都熟
lines.en: I know every gap in these ruins.
Take two more steps.
The sight has aligned.
Show your head, and I loose.
I am never in a hurry.
The bolt leaves the string.
That was a steady shot.
I change position at once.
I swing the stock down.
It works at close range too.
I re-cock the string.

lines.zh: 我的弩托磕在你护甲上
lines.en: My stock cracks against your armour.
I step back to reload.
This is tribunal craftsmanship.
Do not move; stand still.
I step out from behind the broken wall.
The crossbow is already cocked.
I take my place in the open.
The wind lifts my cloak.
I am looking for high ground.
I raise the crossbow and scan.
Only I remain of this squad.
There are many echoes in these ruins.
I am in position.
The field of fire ahead is clear.
My armour grows too hot to touch.
I fall from a height.

lines.zh: 我戴着面罩,水进不来也出不去
lines.en: Masked, water cannot get in and cannot get out.
The blast tears my cloak.
An arrow lodges in my leg plate.

lines.zh: 那股力量压得我抬不起弩
lines.en: That force keeps me from lifting the crossbow.

lines.zh: 我把最后的口粮吃完了
lines.en: I have eaten my last ration.

lines.zh: 雷打在盔甲上,我站不稳
lines.en: Lightning on my armour leaves me unsteady.

lines.zh: 这里没有可以支撑的墙
lines.en: There is no wall to brace against here.
